notes.title: Full Release Patch 1.0:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Final 3 dungeons released, levels 7 through 9
[*] Full controller support added, available through in game settings menu
[*] Weapon balance changed
[*] Rifle reload removed
[*] Final 3 bosses added
[*] Leveling up provides additional sins
[*] Life count before wipe increased to 5
[*] Light Hammer damage scales from healing power now
[*] Giant list of bug fixes
[*] Boss balance changes regarding health and attack damage, range, hitboxes, projectile damage and hitboxes, and more
[*] Boss loot drop changes, bosses are now more likely to drop legendary items, or guaranteed to in our longer dungeons
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 21st March 2024
notes.content:
- Removed animation cancelling.  Dodging now shaves off end frames of moves, but you have to wait through them.
- Reduced speed of first boss, and damage of attacks.
- Minor changes to tutorial
- Base attack damage on bow abilities increased
- Invincibility iFrame handling reworked to fix various invinciblity bugs
- Corpse grinder corpse throw and fetch adjusted, along with balance changes
- Added weight system to attacks to make them feel more punchy, along with new particle fx and sound fx
